title: FireSmoke Zarr
description: This dataset provides four-times-daily atmospheric smoke dispersion forecasts for Canada, generated by the BlueSky Canada modeling system from the Weather Forecast Research Team at the University of British Columbia. It is a reprocessed, cloud-optimized zarr-v3 version of the FireSmoke forecast product, updated continuously via automated GitHub Actions workflows.

## README.md
# BlueSky Canada Smoke Forecast in zarr-v3

This data product contains the [BlueSky Canada smoke forecast](https://firesmoke.ca/about/) from the Weather Forecast Research Team at the University of British Columbia, reprocessed in zarr-v3 format.

It updates 4 times daily from Github Actions workflows.

* Github: https://github.com/alukach/firesmoke/
* FireSmoke: https://firesmoke.ca
